title: Smart Data Models - AIXM - VerticalStructure
description: All fixed and mobile objects, or parts thereof that extend above the surface of the Earth. Those objects are considered obstacles and are located on an area intended for the surface movement of aircraft or extend above a defined surface intended to protect aircraft in flight. (AIXM 5.2 feature VerticalStructure. One NGSI-LD entity per AIXM feature; its attributes are the properties of one TimeSlice, normally the current BASELINE, flattened at entity level, with validTime and the other TimeSlice properties kept as attributes. Property names kept verbatim; nested AIXM <<object>> types keep their structure.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:VerticalStructure:<gml:identifier UUID>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VerticalStructure'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

identifier.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeature.html#identifier'. gml:identifier of the AIXM feature (codeSpace urn:uuid:): a UUID that stays the same in every TimeSlice of the feature. The NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:<feature>:<identifier>.

endPosition.description: gml:endPosition of the gml:TimePeriod. Absent when the end is indeterminate (indeterminatePosition='unknown'), i.e. until further notice.

validTime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#validTime'. gml:validTime of the TimeSlice whose properties are carried by this entity: the period during which these values are effective. The efffectivity of the TimeSlice.

interpretation.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#interpretation'. Property indicating how the timeslice is to be interpreted. See the AIXM Temporality model for details. Normally BASELINE (or SNAPSHOT) for an NGSI-LD entity, which carries the full state of the feature.

sequenceNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#sequenceNumber'. Used for the identification of the Time Slice concerned. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

correctionNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#correctionNumber'. Used for indicating the order of the corrections of a Time Slice. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

endPosition.description: gml:endPosition of the gml:TimePeriod. Absent when the end is indeterminate (indeterminatePosition='unknown'), i.e. until further notice.

featureLifetime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#featureLifetime'. The start and end of life of the feature. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#name'. The name of the vertical structure, if applicable.

aixmType.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#type'. AIXM property 'type', renamed to aixmType (NGSI-LD reserved term). An indication of the type of vertical structure, such as building, tower, cable, etc. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

lighted.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#lighted'. A simple indication that the vertical surface is lighted, when no further details are available. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

markingICAOStandard.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#markingICAOStandard'. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

group.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#group'. An indication that the vertical structure consists of a number of closely situated similar objects. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

lightingICAOStandard.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#lightingICAOStandard'. An indication that the lighting of a vertical structure used as criteria the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standard as described in Annex 14. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

synchronisedLighting.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#synchronisedLighting'. marked.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#marked'. A simple indication that the vertical structure is marked, when no further details are available. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

designator.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#designator'. A coded identifier associated with the structure, taken from a national or local obstacle registry.

dataAssessmentStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#dataAssessmentStatus'. arrestingDevice.description: Relationship. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructure.html#arrestingDevice'. The VerticalStructure is an arresting device. Reference to the AIXM feature ArrestingGear: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not an AIXM property (Smart Data Models addition): GeoJSON copy of the horizontal projection (location, linearExtent or surfaceExtent) of the vertical structure parts, in longitude/latitude order, so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work. The AIXM property is kept unchanged.

ElevatedCurve.description: AIXM geometry ElevatedCurve. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_ElevatedCurve.html'. A one-dimensional geometric primitive, representing the continuous image of a line which is extended with properties that represent the vertical position (elevation, datum, accuracy).

geometry.description: The GML geometry of the AIXM ElevatedCurve (gml:pos / gml:posList, EPSG:4326) encoded as GeoJSON (longitude, latitude order). Smart Data Models encoding of the GML part; arcs and circles (ArcByCenterPoint, CircleByCenterPoint) must be densified to positions.

elevation.description: The vertical distance at the curve level, measured from Mean Sea Level (MSL). Units: given by uom.

LightElement.description: AIXM <<object>> LightElement. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_LightElement.html'. An elementary light source, part of a lighting system.

colour.description: An indication of the colour of the lights in a light element group. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

intensityLevel.description: An indication of the relative intensity of the lights in a light element group. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for light intensity.

intensity.description: The exact value of the intensity of the lights in a light element group. Units: given by uom.

type.description: An indication of the type of light source. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

location.description: Identifies the geospatial location of the Light Element.

availability.description: The operational status of the LightElement.

direction.description: An indication of the light emission direction. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

lightingTechnology.description: An indication of the lighting technology used to emit light. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

LightElementStatus.description: AIXM <<object>> LightElementStatus. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_LightElementStatus.html'. The description of the operational status of the Light Element.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

status.description: An indication of the operational status of the light element. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

LinguisticNote.description: AIXM <<object>> LinguisticNote. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_LinguisticNote.html'. The note content expressed in a specific language. As a minimum, all Notes shall be expressed in English.

note.description: The text of the Note, in a specific language.

Note.description: AIXM <<object>> Note. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Note.html'. A general text note for a feature or for one of its properties.

propertyName.description: The name of the feature property for which this note is relevant, if applicable. If no propertyName is specified, then the Note is relevant for the feature as a whole.

purpose.description: An indication of the goal which led to the provision of the free text note. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

Timesheet.description: AIXM <<object>> Timesheet. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Timesheet.html'. The definition of a single time interval, that occurs repeatedly as part of a schedule.

timeReference.description: An indicator of the time reference system or reference system offset (for example, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), or UTC minus 7 hours), applied to the time, day and date values specified in the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

startDate.description: The start date of the validity of a timesheet. Used together with a timesheet's 'EndDate' to express repetitive time periods like 15 May to 15 November.

endDate.description: The end date of the validity of a timesheet. Used together with a timesheet's 'StartDate' to express repetitive time periods like 15 May to 15 November.

day.description: An indicator of the day the timesheet is referring to. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

dayTil.description: An indicator of the days affected by a timesheet, as follows: if the value of this attribute is left blank, the 'EndTime', 'EndEvent', 'EndTimeRelativeEvent' and 'endEventInterpretation' values of a timesheet must be considered as occurring on the day specified. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

startTime.description: The time of the day (specified in the timesheet's 'day' attribute) when the period described in the timesheet starts.

startEvent.description: A reference to an event (like sunset or sunrise), the occurrence of which indicates when the period described in a timesheet starts. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for time. For example, seconds, minutes, hours

startTimeRelativeEvent.description: The number of minutes before or after the event referred to by the timesheet's 'StartEvent' when the period described in the timesheet starts. Units: given by uom.

startEventInterpretation.description: When both the 'StartTime' and 'StartEvent' values of a timesheet are not blank, this explains how the combination of the two values should be interpreted, i.e. which of the two moments in time is the beginning of the period described by the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

endTime.description: The time of the day when the period described in the timesheet ends.

endEvent.description: A reference to an event (like sunset or sunrise), the occurrence of which indicates when the period described in a timesheet ends. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for time. For example, seconds, minutes, hours

endTimeRelativeEvent.description: The number of minutes before or after an event, referred to by the timesheet's 'EndEvent', when the period described in the timesheet ends. Units: given by uom.

endEventInterpretation.description: When both the 'EndTime' and 'EndEvent' values of a timesheet are not blank, this attribute explains how the combination of the two attributes should be interpreted, i.e. which of the two moments in time is the end of the period described by the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

daylightSavingAdjust.description: Indicates that the 'StartTime' and 'EndTime' values of a timesheet have to be decreased by one hour when Daylight Saving is in force (summer time). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

excluded.description: An indicator that the time block indicated by a timesheet is excluded (subtracted) from the total time interval(s) defined by one or more additional timesheet(s). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

VerticalStructureLightingStatus.description: AIXM <<object>> VerticalStructureLightingStatus. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructureLightingStatus.html'. The description of the operational status of the Vertical Structure lighting.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

status.description: An indication of the operational status of the lighting for a vertical structure. For example, serviceable, unserviceable, work in progress, etc. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

VerticalStructurePart.description: AIXM <<object>> VerticalStructurePart. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_VerticalStructurePart.html'. A part of the vertical structure that can be represented as point, line or polygon with vertical extent.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

verticalExtent.description: The vertical extent of the vertical structure part. Units: given by uom.

type.description: An indicator of the type of vertical structure part, such as building, tower, cable, etc. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

constructionStatus.description: The status of construction of the man-made object that constitutes the vertical structure part. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

markingPattern.description: The general layout of the external paint or another marking element, intended to increase the visibility of the vertical structure part. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

markingFirstColour.description: The principal colour of the marking of the vertical structure part. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

markingSecondColour.description: The secondary colour for the marking of the vertical structure part. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

mobile.description: An indicator that the vertical structure part is expected to move around its nominal location. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

frangible.description: An indicator that the vertical structure part is easily broken. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

visibleMaterial.description: An indicator of the type(s) of material that compose the load-bearing structure and/or exterior facing of a vertical construction (for example: a building or non-building structure). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

designator.description: A distinguishing label by which the vertical structure part is identified locally.

horizontalProjection_surfaceExtent.description: Indicates the horizontal projection of the VerticalStructurePart and the elevation of its top.

horizontalProjection_location.description: Indicates the horizontal projection of the VerticalStructurePart and the elevation of its top.

horizontalProjection_linearExtent.description: Indicates the horizontal projection of the VerticalStructurePart and the elevation of its top.

lighting.description: Identifies the Light Elements installed on the Vertical StructurePart.

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

height.description: The maximum distance from the top of the vertical structure to the ground underneath (at the same position). Units: given by uom.
